scope: Original 4B checkpoint and three fixtures; 128 requests; max_tokens256. GPU-token two-step profile selected by the predeclared C64/VF4 screen, with VF2 only as an admission fallback; fixed before this independent R128 comparison. Each keeps its qualifying prefill wait. A >=5% forward lead receives an immediate reverse-order check; failed forward profiles are not repeated unless their result may still qualify. The alternative is left unrun if the wider profile establishes a repeated win. Fresh vLLM C64 automatic-cache controls before and after the symmetric native sequence. Prefix and processor caches disabled; media UUID unique. No own compilation or sampling during timings; shared machine otherwise uncontrolled.
